Or maybe it was Naples. It's so hot down there, I don't know how they stand it. My sister went to Florida once for a vacation and got the most terrible sunburn on her shoulders... \n\nBut anyway, what was I saying? Oh, reading. I don't know, really. I just don't know if my mind wanders or not. Well, my regular doctor checks my blood pressure whenever I go in, and I did have some routine blood drawn at my check-up last fall. But they didn't say anything was wrong, no concerns at all. Everything was completely normal.

No, no surgery. I haven't been put under anesthesia or had any major health issues like that. I really try to stay away from hospitals if I can help it. The food is always so terribly bland, isn't it?

She bought it at a rummage sale at the Methodist church back in... oh, it must have been 1968.

We spent the whole summer there, swimming until our fingers turned into little prunes and our hair smelled like chlorine for days. There was this one lifeguard, Tommy, who used to blow his whistle at us if we ran on the wet concrete. He had this bright white zinc oxide smeared all over his nose so it wouldn't burn. My husband used to do that too when we went fishing down at the lake. He had this old aluminum rowboat that rattled something awful whenever you started the little outboard motor. Oh, dear me. I've completely lost the thread again, haven't I? I am so, so sorry. I start talking about hospital food and end up on a fishing boat! What was your question? Did you ask if I like to fish?
